“Peace, commerce, and honest friendship with all nations, entangling alliances with none.” – Thomas Jefferson.  
 
The Founders warned against permanent alliances, foreign commitments, and interference in other nations' affairs. American foreign policy in the 21st century violates those warnings. In the new issue of Free Society, Cato's @brandan_buck and @Hoffman8Jon explain what a return to first principles would look like.
